entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_denki_00

entries.text:
Levincia Gym Leader: Iono
(AKA the Supercharged Streamer)

This Electric-type user and hit streamer
is adored by the young. Her viewers’
reactions are more important to her
than victory in battle, and her Gym Test
is one-of-a-kind. Be ready for anything!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_denki

entries.text: Head outside to take the Gym Test!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_denki_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Iono in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_denki_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_esper_00

entries.text:
Alfornada Gym Leader: Tulip
(AKA the Bewitching Beautician)

This Psychic-type user is a real force,
even among Gym Leaders. She runs a
cosmetics brand, which she also models
for, and she aims to be the very best in
everything she does—including battle.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_esper

entries.text: Successfully take part in\nEmotional Spectrum Practice!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_esper_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Tulip in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_esper_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_ghost_00

entries.text:
Montenevera Gym Leader: Ryme
(AKA the MC of RIP)

This Ghost-type user is among the very
greatest. She is a legendary rapper who
has performed around the world, and
her thrilling live shows rattle the bones
with devilish beats and Double Battles.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_ghost

entries.text: Get the crowd all warmed up by\nperforming one great opening act!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_ghost_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Ryme in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_ghost_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_koori_00

entries.text:
Glaseado Gym Leader: Grusha
(AKA the Sub-zero Shredder)

This Ice-type user, once a renowned
snowboarder, was forced to retire from
the sport due to a grievous injury.
His formerly fiery passion now remains
locked away beneath a thick, icy shell.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_koori

entries.text: Talk to the staffer to try your hand at\nthe Gym Test and go sliding down the\nmountainside!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_koori_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Grusha in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_koori_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_kusa_00

entries.text:
Artazon Gym Leader: Brassius
(AKA the Verdant Virtuoso)

This Grass-type user and artist is a first
stop for many fledgling Trainers. His
sculptures of Grass-type Pokémon are
as famous as the way he chooses to
appear before challengers to his Gym.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_kusa

entries.text: Talk to the lady on the Sunflora Lawn\nto get started on your Gym Test!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_kusa_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Brassius in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_kusa_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mizu_00

entries.text:
Cascarrafa Gym Leader: Kofu
(AKA the Surging Chef)

This Water-type user is a good fit for
those with battle experience. He is the
chef and owner of the Kofu Lounge,
and his zeal for helping Trainers grow
has led him to craft a taxing Gym Test.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mizu

entries.text: Find Gym Leader Kofu and deliver\nhis forgotten wallet to him in Porto\nMarinada!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mizu_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Kofu in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mizu_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mushi_00

entries.text:
Cortondo Gym Leader: Katy
(AKA the Sugarbug)

This Bug-type user is a recommended
first stop for anyone considering taking
on the Pokémon League. Though sweet
as a treat, this baker of bug-themed
pastries shows a bold streak in battle.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mushi

entries.text: Talk to the staffer at the olive-rolling\nfield to try your hand at the Gym Test!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mushi_02

entries.text: Report back to the Gym lobby about\nyour success so you can take on Gym\nLeader Katy in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_mushi_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_normal_00

entries.text:
Medali Gym Leader: Larry
(AKA the Exceptional Everyman)

This Normal-type user is in the middle
of the pack when it comes to Gym
Leaders. He has a day job helping run
the Pokémon League, where he is not
the best-rated worker. He loves to eat.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_normal

entries.text: Order the special secret menu item\nat the Treasure Eatery!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_normal_02

entries.text: Report back to the waiter at the\nTreasure Eatery so you can take on\nGym Leader Larry in battle!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_GYM_normal_03

entries.text:
Ortega of the Ruchbah Squad
(Boss of Team Star’s Fairy crew)

Said to be the second strongest of the
Team Star bosses. His family owns an
apparel brand famed even in Paldea.
He constantly looks down on others,
perhaps due to his cushy upbringing.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_DAN_fairy

entries.text:
Atticus of the Navi Squad
(Boss of Team Star’s Poison crew)

Atticus is of middling strength among
the Team Star bosses. A descendant of
ninjas—or so he believes—he likes to
dress the part and use fancy speech
and poison skills to toy with foes.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_DAN_doku

entries.text:
Eri of the Caph Squad
(Boss of Team Star’s Fighting crew)

An extremely dangerous opponent,
even among the Team Star bosses.
She entered the academy on a sports
scholarship. Her towering height helps
her unleash powerful wrestling moves.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_DAN_kakutou

entries.text:
Giacomo of the Segin Squad
(Boss of Team Star’s Dark crew)

Since he only recently began training
Dark-type Pokémon, he’s not too much
challenge in battle. He used to be a
straitlaced star student, but certain
events set him on a very different path.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_DAN_aku

entries.text:
Mela of the Schedar Squad
(Boss of Team Star’s Fire crew)

Mela believes in solving every problem
with force, and she is scarier to face
than her Pokémon. But she has charisma
and always keeps her word, which has
earned her the trust of her allies.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_DAN_honoo

entries.text:
The False Dragon Titan
(Information not verified)

A highly dangerous Pokémon said to
lurk in Casseroya Lake, luring other
creatures close and then feeding on
them. Appearance unknown, but mouth
likely large. Use extreme caution.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_NUSHI_dragon

entries.text:
The Lurking Steel Titan
(Information not verified)

Miners working in Area Three of the
East Province say something huge
burrowing under the ground is the
cause of frequent landslides. Whispers
abound whether it could be a Titan.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_NUSHI_hagane

entries.text:
The Open Sky Titan
(Information not verified)

Boulders are tumbling down from a
mountain in the West Province’s Area
One. Perhaps a Titan wanting to keep
the sky all to itself? The climb may be
more challenging than the battle.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_NUSHI_hikou

entries.text:
The Stony Cliff Titan
(Information not verified)

Witnesses claim they’ve seen a giant
stone moving on its own in Area Three
of the South Province. And the stone has
big swiveling eyestalks?! Perhaps it’s a
Titan camouflaging itself to catch prey.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_NUSHI_iwa

entries.text:
The Quaking Earth Titan
(Information not verified)

Mysterious quakes keep shaking the
Asado Desert. Porto Marinada locals
claim they’ve caught glimpses of an
unknown creature raging about through
the obscuring clouds of sand and dust.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_NUSHI_jimen

entries.text:
Okidogi of the Loyal Three

Locals believe worshiping Okidogi will
grant you kindness and help keep things
okeydokey between you and other
people. Okidogi was once a smaller
and weaker Pokémon, but a desire for
strength led it to gain powerful muscles.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_tomokko_inu

entries.text:
Munkidori of the Loyal Three

Locals believe worshiping Munkidori
leads to success in life—that doing so
will make everything hunky-dory.
Munkidori was originally a clumsy and
dim-witted Pokémon, but a longing for
cleverness led it to gain great wisdom.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_tomokko_saru

entries.text:
Fezandipiti of the Loyal Three

Locals believe worshiping Fezandipiti
will lead to good luck and serendipitous
happenings. Fezandipiti was once a
Pokémon with short, dull feathers, but
a wish to be beautiful led it to gain an
exquisite appearance.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_tomokko_kiji

entries.text:
Crispin of the Elite Four
Savanna Plaza | BB League rank: #5

Cooks up amazing, super-spicy dishes
with his fire Pokémon. Still relatively
new to battling but fights tenaciously
with natural talent. Not the most gifted
student. From Virbank City in Unova.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_A_01

entries.text: Take on Crispin’s Elite Trial in the\nSavanna Plaza: making a super-spicy\nsandwich!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_A_02

entries.text: Face off against Crispin of the Elite\nFour at the Savanna Plaza battle court!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_A_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]

entries.text:
Amarys of the Elite Four
Canyon Plaza | BB League rank: #4

Has trained Pokémon since she could
walk and talk. Directs steel Pokémon
precisely to calmly corner opponents.
She’s also student council president.
From Castelia City in Unova.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_B_01

entries.text: Take on Amarys’s Elite Trial in the\nCanyon Plaza: the Flying Time Trial!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_B_02

entries.text: Face off against Amarys of the Elite\nFour at the Canyon Plaza battle court!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_B_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_B_04

entries.text:
Lacey of the Elite Four
Coastal Plaza | BB League rank: #3

This hard worker only catches Pokémon
she finds cute, so she naturally became
a masterful Trainer of Fairy types. She’s
beloved by her fellow students. From
Nimbasa City in Unova.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_C_01

entries.text: Take on Lacey’s Elite Trial in the\nCoastal Plaza: the Pokémon quiz!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_C_02

entries.text: Face off against Lacey of the Elite Four\nat the Coastal Plaza battle court!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_C_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 247]
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_C_04

entries.text:
Drayton of the Elite Four
Polar Plaza | BB League rank: #2

A very capable Trainer of Dragon types
who firmly believes in having fun at all
times. He’s constantly tired during the
day but stays up late lazing around
anyway. From Opelucid City in Unova.
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_D_01

entries.text: Take on Drayton’s Elite Trial in the\nPolar Plaza: Terarium-Only Battles!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_D_02

entries.text: Face off against Drayton of the Elite\nFour at the Polar Plaza battle court!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_SDC02_4KINGS_D_03

entries.text:
Everyone’s picked an area of the
community center to search. Claim your
own area to search and track down the
missing TV remote!

entries.text: Head outside to look for Nemona!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_S2_SIDE01_0090

entries.text: Ask the nearby villagers if they know\nwhere Nemona went!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_S2_SIDE01_0095

entries.text: Chase down the mysterious Pokémon!\nIt fled toward Loyalty Plaza!
entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_S2_SIDE01_0170

entries.label: ymap_mission_guide_SCENARIO_S2_SIDE01_0180
